entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF88-1209-45B.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... I see the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 23rd. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It doesn't matter. I tried to return this last week. Your entire system was down. I'm just doing it now because I finally have a free minute.
I understand. I can see you received it 16 days ago. When you say you tried last week, do you recall the date?
Yes, it was January 1st. My 9th day. I went to the returns page and there was a huge website error. I couldn't print the label or even submit the form. I took a screenshot if you need proof.

Thank you for that information. Let me check my notes... Ah, yes. You are absolutely right. We had a major system down event that day that affected our portal. My sincere apologies you were impacted by that.
So can I return it or not?

Yes, of course. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you... Okay, according to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. So I can absolutely get this processed for you right now.

I've just sent that to the email on file. And because you're a VIP member and had to deal with our technical issue, I've gone ahead and added a $50 credit to your account for a future purchase. We value your business and apologize again for the inconvenience.
Okay. I got the email. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Have a wonderful day and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
